title: Cherry Tomato Linguine
subtitle: with basil and parmesan
description: Linguine tossed in a quick cherry tomato, garlic and basil sauce with plenty of parmesan. Ready in about 20 minutes.

steps.text: Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions. Meanwhile, make the sauce.
Heat olive oil and add the garlic and cherry tomatoes. Fry, stirring, for about 5 minutes.
Roughly chop the basil leaves and add them with the seasonings. Fry for 2 minutes, stirring.
Add half a cup of the pasta cooking water and cook for about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked pasta, mix, and stir in 3 tablespoons of the parmesan.
Check the pasta is done, transfer to a serving dish and top with the remaining parmesan.
